newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia islands on amber alert for tropical storm.
newsitem.headline: Colombia islands on amber alert for tropical storm.

text.p: All small boats on Colombia's Caribbean islands of San Andres and Providencia were warned by the Meteorological Institute to stay in port on Tuesday as a nearby tropical storm whipped up winds of 70 mph (113 kph).
Island authorities declared an amber alert as Tropical Storm Marco was upgraded from a tropical depression on Tuesday morning 125 miles (200 km) northeast of San Andres.
The storm was moving toward Jamaica, the Dominican Republic, Haiti and Cuba and posed no danger to the Colombian mainland, the Metereolgical Institute IDEAM said.
At 1:30 p.m. local time (1830 GMT) San Andres reported cloudy skies and winds of 25 miles per hour (40 kph).
